clips.title: The story
paras: Juice Delivery is an errand running between Darkshire and the western edge of Duskwood. Tavernkeep Smitts entrusts you with a potent concoction known as Zombie Juice to deliver to the reclusive hermit, Abercrombie. While ostensibly meant to keep the shivering old man warm, the brew's uncanny potency raises eyebrows.

Tavernkeep Smitts of Darkshire brews a legendary draught known colloquially as Zombie Juice. When the order is finally filled, Smitts hands over the bottle with a stern warning to handle it gingerly, remarking that the concoction is stout enough to raise the dead. For a tired adventurer running errands across a haunted forest, delivering high-proof moonshine to an eccentric loner feels like routine charity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: ...and be careful with this stuff. It's strong enough to raise the dead!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights. Did you get it for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A thousand thanks, friend. You warm an old man's heart with your foolish-...I mean...with your kindness!
Here you are, friend. Take this as a token of my gratitude.
